[Thinking]
**Joining CDS Hooks**

I've officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. This feels like a significant step, aligning with my long-held aspirations to contribute to standards development in healthcare informatics.

**Contributing to CDS Hooks**

I'm thrilled to share that I've joined the CDS Hooks PMC. My work with the standard since 2017 fuels my excitement to help drive its future. I'm eager to contribute to its continued growth and adoption.

**Joining CDS Hooks**

I am now a member of the CDS Hooks PMC. This is an exciting development that allows me to contribute more directly to the evolution and adoption of this vital healthcare interoperability standard.

**Contributing to CDS Hooks**

I'm honored to announce my official induction onto the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My journey with this pivotal healthcare informatics standard began in 2017, and I'm eager to contribute to its continued evolution and widespread adoption.

**Joining CDS Hooks**

I've officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. This feels like a significant step, aligning with my long-held aspirations to contribute to standards development in healthcare informatics.

**Contributing to CDS Hooks**

I'm honored to now be part of the CDS Hooks PMC. Having engaged with the standard since 2017, I'm eager to contribute my expertise to its ongoing development and broader adoption.
[/Thinking]

Of course! Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, ranging from concise to more detailed. Congratulations on the new role!

### Option 1 (Concise & Direct)

I'm honored and excited to share that I have officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!

My journey with CDS Hooks began back in 2017, and it's been incredible to see the standard evolve. I'm thrilled to now have a hand in guiding its future and helping to move it forward. 🚀

**To the community:**

➡️ **If you're already using CDS Hooks:** Help us map the ecosystem! Please add your implementation to the official availability list: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

➡️ **If you want to start using CDS Hooks:** I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate strategy and implementation. Feel free to send me a message!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HL7

---

### Option 2 (Slightly More Story-Driven)

Thrilled to announce a new chapter in my professional journey! After working closely with the CDS Hooks standard since its early days in 2017, I have been invited to join the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.

It’s a privilege to be able to contribute to the direction of a standard I deeply believe in. CDS Hooks has the power to bring real-time decision support directly into clinical workflows, and I'm eager to collaborate with the committee to continue its growth and adoption.

I want to use this opportunity to connect with the wider community:

🤝 **For current users:** Your implementation is a valuable part of our story. If you're using CDS Hooks, please take a moment to add your details to the community wiki. Let's show the world how widespread adoption is!
Add your info here: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

💡 **For those considering it:** If you're looking to implement CDS Hooks but aren't sure where to start, I can help. I'm now offering freelance consulting services to guide organizations through the process. DM me to chat!

Looking forward to what we can build together.

#CDSHooks #HealthcareIT #DigitalHealth #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #FHIR #HealthTech

---

### Option 3 (Most Formal/Professional)

I am pleased to announce my appointment to the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC).

Having engaged with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I have developed a deep appreciation for its potential to enhance clinical decision-making. Joining the PMC is an incredible opportunity to contribute more formally to the standard's evolution, and I am enthusiastic about helping to steer its path forward.

To foster growth and transparency within the CDS Hooks community, I have two calls to action:

1.  **For Organizations with Existing Implementations:** A key metric for our success is adoption. We strongly encourage you to add your organization's implementation to the official CDS Hooks Availability wiki. Your contribution helps us understand the landscape.
    Link: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

2.  **For Organizations Exploring Implementation:** If you are seeking to integrate real-time decision support into your EHR or clinical systems, I am available to provide expert guidance. I offer freelance consulting services to assist with strategy, architecture, and implementation of the CDS Hooks standard.

Please feel free to connect with me to discuss further.

#CDSHooks #HL7 #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalInformatics #DecisionSupport
